policies.title: Russian ordinary passport: citizen entry
policies.summary: A Russian national using an ordinary Russian passport is classified as citizenship rather than as a foreign visitor-visa relationship.
conditions: Article 27(2) establishes a Russian citizen's right to return freely. This classification is limited to Russian citizenship and does not establish a rule for dual nationals travelling as foreign citizens or for non-national travel documents.

policies.title: Russia: ordinary passports visa-free up to 90 days
policies.summary: The current MFA country table gives these ordinary-passport nationalities a visa-free short-visitor baseline of up to 90 days.
conditions: The country table's stated 90-day ordinary-passport or all-passport waiver controls; passport validity, migration registration, purpose, admission and any shorter treaty condition remain applicable.
This is not a work, residence, diplomatic, service, crew, APEC-card, local-border or special-document classification.

policies.title: Russia: ordinary passports visa-free where the current MFA table states no duration
policies.summary: The current MFA country table expressly says these nationalities are visa-free for all passport types but does not state a nationality-specific duration in the displayed entry.
conditions: Do not infer an unlimited visitor stay from the table's silence on duration; immigration, registration, document and final-admission rules remain applicable.
The stated all-passport waivers may also permit specified internal identity documents, but this policy covers the ordinary passport relationship only.

policies.title: Russia: ordinary passports visa-free up to 30 days
policies.summary: The current MFA table gives these ordinary passports a short visa-free baseline of up to 30 days.
conditions: Bosnia and Herzegovina is limited to 30 days in 60; the other displayed ordinary-passport waivers state up to 30 days.
This excludes diplomatic, service, crew, APEC-card, invitation, organized-tour and other special routes.

policies.title: Russia: ordinary passports visa-free up to 60 days
policies.summary: The current MFA table gives Dominican Republic, Republic of Korea, Mauritius, Samoa and Cabo Verde ordinary passports a visa-free stay of up to 60 days.
conditions: This is the ordinary-passport visitor baseline only; it excludes the separately listed diplomatic, service, accredited-staff and other document routes.

policies.title: Russia: Brunei and Nauru ordinary passports visa-free up to 14 days
policies.summary: The current MFA table records a 14-day visa-free short-stay rule for Brunei and Nauru.
conditions: This is a short visitor baseline; purpose, passport, registration and final border-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Russia: Chinese ordinary passports temporarily visa-free
policies.summary: The MFA table grants Chinese ordinary passports visa-free entry for up to 30 days only through 14 September 2026.
conditions: This is a temporary ordinary-passport waiver. The table separately lists diplomatic/service treatment, organized-tour groups, crews and APEC-card routes.
Recheck after 14 September 2026; the unified e-visa route is separately available.

policies.title: Russia: Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents with the stated SAR passports visa-free
policies.summary: The MFA table limits the Hong Kong and Macao passport waivers to permanent residents holding the respective valid SAR passport.
conditions: Hong Kong is up to 14 days and Macao up to 30 days, each only for a permanent resident holding the matching valid SAR passport.
This does not infer eligibility for another Chinese, British, Portuguese, residence or travel-document category.

policies.title: Russia: Serbian biometric ordinary passports visa-free up to 30 days
policies.summary: The MFA table makes the Serbian ordinary-passport waiver conditional on a biometric passport and limits it to 30 days.
conditions: Only an ordinary biometric Serbian passport is covered, for up to 30 days; diplomatic and service rules are separate.

policies.title: Russia: Omani ordinary passports visa-free with annual cap
policies.summary: The MFA table gives Omani ordinary passports visa-free entry up to 30 days per visit, capped at 90 days in a calendar year.
conditions: The 30-day-per-visit and 90-day-per-calendar-year limits apply. The e-visa is an alternative route, not an extension of the visa-free allowance.

policies.title: Russia: Saudi ordinary passports visa-free with annual cap
policies.summary: The MFA table grants Saudi Arabian ordinary passports visa-free entry for up to 90 days in a calendar year.
conditions: The 90-days-per-calendar-year cap applies. The unified e-visa remains an alternative, more restrictive route.

policies.title: Russia: Myanmar ordinary passports visa-free with annual cap
policies.summary: The current MFA country table grants Myanmar ordinary passports visa-free entry up to 30 days per visit, with a 90-day calendar-year cap.
conditions: The 30-day-per-visit and 90-day-per-calendar-year limits apply. The live unified-eVisa portal still lists Myanmar, so this current table-controlled visa-free baseline needs monitoring.

policies.title: Russia: named ordinary passports eligible for the unified electronic visa
policies.summary: The current MFA country table identifies this cohort as eligible for a unified e-visa. The portal confirms an issued unified e-visa is an actual single-entry electronic visa, not merely an online application or authorization.
conditions: Apply no earlier than 86 and no later than 4 days before entry using a machine-readable national passport issued by the nationality state and valid at least six months from application; each child needs a separate e-visa.
It is single entry, valid 120 days from issue, with a stay of no more than 30 calendar days, through only approved border crossing points. Arrival and departure days both count.
Visitor purposes are private/business visits, tourism, and the stated scientific, cultural, socio-political, economic or sporting events. Other purposes require a regular visa.

Movement is barred to territories, organisations and facilities requiring a special permit. Insurance is required unless reciprocity exempts the nationality; approval and admission remain discretionary.

application.label: Russian MFA unified e-visa application
application.processingTime: No more than 4 calendar days from submission.
steps: Create a personal account on the official MFA e-visa website or use its mobile application.
Submit the application between 86 and 4 days before entry, pay the required fee and respond to any correction request.
Download or save the positive e-visa notification and show it to the carrier and border officer at an approved crossing point.

policies.title: Russia: other modelled ordinary foreign passports require a regular visa
policies.summary: For these nationalities, the current MFA country table states either visas for all passports or only a non-ordinary waiver and does not provide the unified e-visa. The MFA's general rule therefore requires a regular visa.
conditions: This is the ordinary foreign-passport short-visitor baseline. Diplomatic, official, service, special, crew, accredited-staff, APEC-card, group-tour, invitation, local-border and other stated exceptions are not passport-wide access.

A regular visa is obtained through a Russian diplomatic mission or consular post at the person's place of permanent residence. Visa type, invitation, validity, document recognition, purpose, registration and admission requirements remain case-specific.
